ms.promise:
For the DJED analytics dashboard milestone, we propose the development of:
・A dedicated publicly accessible dashboard section on the Open DJED app
・The inclusion of key DJED metrics (KPIs and other relevant data not otherwise easily accessible) in the format of visualizations (charts, graphs and other interactive components)
・New backend API endpoints to serve aggregated data to the dashboard and third parties

This dashboard will take inspiration from Ethena's dashboard page, where the wildly popular Ethereum DeFi product includes important key metrics related to the USDe and sUSDe markets (performance) and risk.
Maintenance of Open DJED and user support for the 3rd month after proposal start.
ms.criteria:

ms.promise:
The milestone outputs for this milestone are:
・An integrated internationalization (i18n) framework
・Complete translations of the UI and error messages to common DeFi languages, including EN, ES, PT, DE, FR, CN, JA
・A language switcher component on the UI for users to select their preferred language
・End-user guide (how to mint/redeem) and exploration of core DJED protocol concepts for end-users in an article or video format
・Detailed developer documentation for the API and integration flows
・Reference documentation for the public Open DJED SDK (markdown and source code documentation)
・A publicly accessible documentation site (e.g., using GitHub pages)
・Maintenance of Open DJED and user support for the 4th month after proposal start.
ms.criteria:
The acceptance criteria for this milestone are:
・The platform is fully usable and understandable in all aforementioned language
・The language switcher changes the application's selected language and saves the user's preference across sessions
・A fallback to English is implemented for any untranslated texts or errors
・The documentation is clear, well-structured, and hosted on a publicly accessible documentation site that is functional, easily navigable, and maintained in an up-to-date format.
・The end-user guide is sufficient for a new DJED user (with entry level Cardano DeFi experience) to suc

・The documentation is publicly accessible, well-structured, easy to navigate, and kept up to date

・The documentation source files are publicly available in the Open DJED GitHub mono-repository
